usage: gbp-health.py [-h] [--write] [--format {md,json}] [config]

Report Google Business Profile API readiness without making API calls. GBP API
access is gated by Google's OAuth verification for the business.manage scope —
a real approval process, not just keys. Until it is granted the honest status
is `needs_oauth_verification`, and the working path stays the browser workflow
(prompts/local/google-maps.md via Chrome MCP) plus manual exports ingested by
`gbp-fetch.py --input-file`.

positional arguments:
  config              Path to seo-cycle.yaml

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
  --write             Write seo/setup/gbp-health.* artifacts.
  --format {md,json}
